# Can you catch them all?!

Relax, Fish, and Collect in the World’s #1 VR Fishing Game!
Bait! invites you to cast your line, reel in the fun, and **complete your Fishodex** in this immersive, relaxing VR fishing experience, enjoyed by millions of players worldwide. Whether you’re a seasoned angler or new to fishing, explore vibrant lakes, catch a variety of fish, and collect them all to complete your ultimate fishing collection—all from the comfort of your home.

# Key Features:
- 🎣 Fish Across 8 Scenic Lakes – Cast your line in **beautiful locations**, each offering a unique fishing experience.
- 🐟 Catch Over 60 Types of Fish – **Complete your Fishodex** by collecting everything from common catches to rare, elusive species. Can you reel them all in?
- 👥 Multiplayer Fishing – Go fishing with up to 4 friends and enjoy the peaceful waters together.
- 🧰 Customize Your Gear – Choose from a variety of rods, reels, and bobbers to suit your fishing style.
- 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Meta Avatar Integration – Play as your personalized Meta avatar and immerse yourself fully in the experience.

# New Features: Explore and Unwind at Casters' Cove!
Take a break from fishing and visit Casters' Cove, a serene social destination where up to 12 virtual anglers can gather. Toss a beach ball, race RC boats, search for treasure, or simply relax and enjoy the peaceful surroundings. It’s the perfect place to unwind and make new friends.

# What Else Can You Do at Casters' Cove?
⚽ Beach Fun – Toss a ball, skip stones, or just relax by the shore.
🚤 RC Boat Racing – Compete with friends in fun remote-controlled boat races.
💰 Treasure Hunts – Explore the island for hidden treasures and surprises.


# Join Millions of Players and Cast Your Line Today!
From reeling in the big catch to completing your Fishodex, Bait! offers a perfect mix of relaxation, collection challenges, and fun. Grab your rod, invite your friends, and dive into the world’s most popular VR fishing game—your next adventure awaits!

changelog.change_log: Fixed an issue with a frozen popup in Treehouse River
Fixed an issue where the game would not load when offline, after updating from a previous version of Bait!
Solves a game freeze bug when returning from Caster's Cove
* This version contains improvements in diagnostics for backend services
* Fixed a bug with french translations

* Added in-game user reporting UI
* Fixed a bug with Grub prices in Dharma Mae's shop
* Improved network traffic in Penguin Point
* The hook in multiplayer is now properly aligned for other players

* Added in-game user reporting UI
* Fixed a bug with Grub prices in Dharma Mae's shop
* Improved network traffic in Penguin Point

- Blocked IAP (in-app purchases) for users below the age of 13 years old.
- Made descriptions for IAP gear and bait show even without an internet connection.
- Moved rods in the Vend-O-Matic slightly, to prevent long handles from clipping into the floor.
- Fixed an issue where the promo for other Resolution Games titles would not appear after changing system language.

* Updated Meta Avatars to v24 for increased avatar fidelity.

* Added the Stealth Black "Wing - Fishin’ Stikk" premium rod to Jim-Bob's Shop.

* Increased the display refresh rate to 90 Hz in single player for Quest 3 and Pro.

* Fixed a bug where you got stuck in loading when going from Casters' Cove to Penguin Point.

This update includes:

- Improved save file error handling

- Fix for a bug where reeling in could be too fast

- Fix for a bug with avatar hairs

- A slew of minor bugs which could cause UI issues were fixed
